title: Austin Debates Ethics, Airport & Convention
summary:
*   **Ethics Ordinance:** Council discussed potential changes, including a controversial proposal for a moratorium on ethics complaints just before elections.
*   **Convention Center:** Reviewed the implementation plan for the new Convention Center, with a decision on the plan expected at a later meeting.
*   **Mueller Airport Contract:** Examined proposed amendments to the contract with Dobbs House, Inc. regarding operations at Mueller Airport, postponing a vote.

TOWN LAKE CENTER
Mayor Cooke called to order the special called meeting of the Council, noting the absence
of Councilmember Humphrey. The Mayor announced the purpose of the meeting was to hold a
worksession on several items.
AMENDMENTS TO DOBBS HOUSE, INC. CONTRACT
Tim Ward, Director of Aviation, gave the history of the Dobbs House involvement with
Mueller Airport. Dave Helfert, chairman, Airport Advisory Board, also discussed the Dobbs
House contract.
Council agreed to bring this subject back for discussion on August 24, 1989.
CAPITAL RECOVERY FEES
Ron Bond reported on the Capital Recovery Fees. ETHICS ORDINANCE City Attorney Barney
Knight discussed the Ethics Ordinance.
Among the issues he discussed was the consideration of a moratorium on ethics complaints
just prior to an election. Mr. Knight said that an ordinance concerning proposed changes
to the Ethics Ordinance will be on a future agenda.
CONVENTION CENTER IMPLEMENTATION PLAN
Mayor Cooke, Kim Peterson, and Diana Granger discussed the Convention Center
Implementation Plan. Mayor Cooke said Council would take action on the plan at the August
24, 1989 Council Meeting.
ADJOURNMENT
The Special Called Meeting of the Council was adjourned at 12:00 Noon.
